scoring_justification: Headline quantities are Monte Carlo simulation averages; the verifier sandbox cannot rerun the long simulation, so it compares the agent's reported results to paper-reported trends and tolerances (T0).

hidden_assets.purpose: All gold values (slope, target temperatures, K values) are inlined in the step descriptions.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper: Fig.1 inset for δh² slope; Figs. 1,6 for order parameter dip/peak at t_PR; Fig.5 for K crossing 2/π² near t≈1.2.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Hardcoded from the paper's reported numbers and verified consistent with the reference solution solve.sh.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are directly taken from the paper's reported physical quantities and are reproduced by the reference oracle.

outputs.description: Finite-size scaling of the mean-square height fluctuation δh² at the preroughening temperature.
Temperature evolution of the sublattice order parameter P and susceptibility χ_P.
Fitted roughness strength K and correlation parameter X for Model A on L=72.

output_contract.notes: Only the SOS model results are required; the dual Coulomb gas and its dielectric constant are excluded.

steps.description: Check that δh² for Model A grows logarithmically with L (slope ≈0.0406) and for Model B shows no significant positive slope.
Verify that P dips and chi_P peaks near the preroughening temperatures (t≈0.5 for A, t≈0.25 for B) and P diminishes at high temperature.
Validate that K at t≈0.5 is ~0.08, that K crosses 2/π²≈0.2026 near t≈1.2, and X is large (≥50) around the transitions.
